title: onobrychis montana var. transsilvanica
intro: Onobrychis montana var. transsilvanica, commonly known as Mountain Spleenwort, is a plant species of the legume family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Spleenwort include wound healing, anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
